meta.title: New member recruitment
meta.description: Join the BUDO CLUB aikido club in Mariánské Lázně. First three training sessions are free.

intro: We are looking for new members for our aikido club in Mariánské Lázně! We welcome complete beginners with no prior martial arts experience.
offers: First three training sessions completely free
Training available for children, teenagers, and adults
howSteps: Come to a training session on Tuesday (18:30) or Friday (17:30)
Bring sweatpants and a long-sleeved shirt
Introduce yourself to the instructor – we will take care of you!
encouragement: There is nothing to be afraid of. Everyone at training was once a complete beginner. The atmosphere is friendly and everyone is happy to help you with your first steps.
